skills.description: Clean up junk files on macOS 13 (Ventura) safely. Scans and cleans system caches, logs, crash reports, trash, temporary files, .DS_Store, development environment caches (npm, pnpm, yarn, pip, maven, gradle, docker, homebrew, Xcode, Go, Rust, Cargo), residual files from uninstalled applications, and large single files over 100MB such as .dmg/.pkg/.iso installers, old archives, VM images, and oversized logs. Uses a safe scan-to-trash workflow: scan first, present a report, get user confirmation, then move items to macOS Trash (recoverable, never permanent deletion). This skill should be used when the user asks to clean up junk files, free disk space, clear caches, remove temp files, clean development caches, or find large files on macOS. Trigger phrases include: 清理垃圾文件, 清理缓存, 释放磁盘空间, 大文件, 清理大文件, clean mac, free up space, clear caches, remove junk files, find large files.
skills.description_zh: MacOS系统内大文件，系统缓存，以及npm、maven、gradle等各种开发缓存。
